paragraphs.text: "We are Mirrodin's children. We will reclaim her—one scrap at a time, if we have to."
Venser wondered if it could still be called a teleportation spell if the destination is oblivion.
"A display of humility is required of those who still possess such frailties." —Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
"The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."
"Your desires have become our discretion." —Izathel, priest of the Annex
Imprisonment teaches revenge. Hobbling teaches resignation.
"Skin is the prison of the blessed and the stronghold of the heretic." —Argent Etchings, plate 64, passage 17
Mirrans were broken down and rebuilt, made to be loyal servants of the force they had fought.
Just one drop of the glistening oil can eventually stain even a soul as stalwart as a loxodon's beyond redemption.
"We are a single entity. Dissenters must be sutured into the Orthodoxy." —Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
With Phyrexia's victory at hand, each sect began perfecting its vision.
"My new design has lightweight plating specially cultivated from heretics' spare tissues." —Izathel, priest of the Annex
When the Mirrans had fallen, Planeswalkers carried the burden of remembrance.
She preaches the blessings of the Machine Orthodoxy.
"That's no glint hawk. The skies have changed for the worse." —Ria Ivor, White Sun partisan
Underling Ethu's 263rd report read simply "Yes, my lord. Overwhelmingly, my lord." This marked the end of the Mirran-Phyrexian War.
"My world is corrupted beyond cleansing. I must prevent this from happening to others." —Karn
"Anything we can do to hurt the Phyrexian invaders is worth dying for."
"Urabrask may suspect our surveillance, but he cannot stop it." —Avaricta, Gitaxian sective
"Flesh is a sickness that infects Phyrexia." —Avaricta, Gitaxian sective
"It isn't for fighting. It's for when the fighting's gone bad." —Kara Vrist, Mirran resistance
"My flesh holds no secrets, monster. The spirit of Mirrodin will fight on." —Vy Covalt, Mirran resistance
"Interrogation is an unnecessary step for acquiring information." —Politus, Gitaxian morphologist
"It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."
"Your first mistake was thinking I would let you live long enough to make a second." —Sarnvax, Gitaxian sective
"Why infiltrate their strongholds when what we seek resides in such a poorly guarded safe?" —Malcator, Executor of Synthesis
"I tolerate Phyrexians because the dragon requires it. But I have no patience for uninvited guests." —Tezzeret
"I appreciate the depravity of noble designs turned to devious ends." —Tezzeret
Each monitor is given an eye for each spire it is to guard.
"This creature is inadequate. Send it to the splicers for innovation." —Malcator, Executor of Synthesis
"I despise Vorinclex and his slobberings about 'evolution.' Only I know true progress." —Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
"I am weak. Make . . . me . . . ideal."
"When terror outweighs all other thoughts, they will understand that I am the true Father of Machines." —Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane
"Truth is always a weapon in your enemies' hands." —Geth, Lord of the Vault
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere." —Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane
Phyrexia extended its command until there was nothing left to take.
"The Accorders would lament the transformation of their cherished lands, had they lived to see it." —Sheoldred, Whispering One
"Everyone should owe you something." —Geth, Lord of the Vault
Even the small wounds let hope bleed out.
The first explosion that didn't excite goblins.
The feeble resistance of the flesh is over. Phyrexia spreads its shadow over all.
"Behold blessed perfection." —Sheoldred, Whispering One
After boring up through the crust of Mirrodin, it turned its expertise upon the surface dwellers.
Sheoldred weaves every thread of information into a noose to hang her enemies.
The nim have become roving killers marshaled by whichever thane holds tenuous leadership.
From the remnants of the dead, Geth forged a swarm to safeguard his throne.
Phyrexian or Mirran, most goblins stick to the job they know best.
"Large or small, all will toil for the Great Work." —Decree of Urabrask
Born of the core, and dying to stoke it.
"The mountains have been corrupted. Otherwise, they would not lend me their fire so easily." —Koth of the Hammer
"Down here, we have a more pointed version of the scriptures." —Urabrask's enforcer
An apocalypse in dragon form.
Even in New Phyrexia, red mana sparks glimmers of individualism, passion, and freedom.
New Phyrexia is an engine that both consumes and creates malice.
"They aren't helping the forges. Send them to the surface." —Furnace boss, sector 12
"For the survival of our people, every conflict must now end in retreat." —Pythor, Mirran resistance
"Squealstokers! Build me a glorious pile of Mirran metal. Then add yourselves to the pile." —Furnace boss, sector 11
"Seal the furnace vents. Admit no others. We'll tend our forges without their tainted ways." —Decree of Urabrask
It runs an endless circuit along the ruined roads of the soon-to-be-forgotten Mirran civilization.
"Tend the molten slag, or be the molten slag." —Urabrask's enforcer
When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."
"The refugees look at these structures with hope. We must relieve them of this burden." —Juex, tormentor exarch
"I will carve my people's vengeance on the face of Phyrexia."
The slag-workers wasted no time in creating their own flare pulses to cleanse the area of the *incompleat*.
"Kill the weak so they can't drag the strong down to their level. This is true compassion." —Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might
"Wipe Sheoldred's spies from the sky. She'll see the result of our vision soon enough." —Glissa
A scavenger's favorite appetizer is death.
"If it were fit to survive, it wouldn't have been so easily put down." —Glissa
"Beg me for life, and I will fill you with the glory of Phyrexian perfection."
"Our ancestors adapted to this world of metal. Just as they did, we will adapt to this world of evil."
A substantial portion of Vorinclex's forces became fuel for the rest.
Once a pariah, now Mirrodin's greatest hope.
"Sympathy is for weaklings. Whoever survives, wins." —Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might
"I wish I could take credit for it, but nature progresses on its own, just the way it should." —Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger
"Dead or alive, my creations are stronger than Jin-Gitaxias's septic minions." —Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger
Vorinclex had no grand plan. The oil did its own work, evolving creatures into worthy predators.
"We do not need beakers and vials to test our predators." —Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger
To secure a place in Phyrexia's ranks, they hunted their surviving kin.
"In the midst of horror beyond imagining, I still see things that lift my heart." —Ezuri
"For every one that falls, ten shall rise. The revelation of New Phyrexia is at hand." —Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger
"As long as my hand holds a blade, there's hope for a pure Mirrodin once again."
With or without witnesses, the suns continued their prismatic dance.
"We thank the souleaters for inscribing our souls with subservience, to reinforce the sacred order." —Drones' hymn of gratitude
"It's the last thing we can call our own." —Minhu, Mirran resistance
Now etched only with the scars of phyresis.
Drawn by power, fueled by conquest.
Originally created to harvest blinkmoths, the hovermyr are now the silent observers of a dying world.
"We thank the souleaters for melting the sinful that we may be reminded of our own insignificance." —Drones' hymn of gratitude
"We thank the souleaters for culling our sick so that the strong may earn their triumphs." —Drones' hymn of gratitude
"Attrition is the answer. Starve them, and let their despair be their undoing." —Sheoldred, Whispering One
If it possesses an ability to understand and appreciate life, it has never shown it.
"Let go of your memories and be reborn." —Argent Etchings, plate 106, passage 27
The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.
Two kinds of myr survive: the powerful and those that stay close by them.
An invasion weapon of ages past, the glistening oil contained the blueprints of countless atrocities.
"Tools and artisans can be destroyed, but the act of creation is inviolate." —Elspeth Tirel
"You have an unhealthy attachment to your selfhood. I can help you with that." —Malcator, Executor of Synthesis
"Let's show Vorinclex that progress doesn't always need teeth or claws." —Malcator, Executor of Synthesis
Without a foe to focus on, the machine priests had time to indulge in new sciences.
"Phyrexia is certainly dangerous, but I have to admire some of its innovations." —Tezzeret
"We thank the souleaters for surveilling our lives that we may be preserved from our own ignorance." —Drones' hymn of gratitude
"The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact. None know its origin, but it gives them hope of a life beyond." —Elspeth's journal
"So even the heart of our world has succumbed." —Koth of the Hammer
